# TeX Live packages the CI installs (zauguin/install-texlive in .github/workflows/build.yml).
# This is everything the CVs load, found by compiling every roles/*/cv-*.tex with
# `pdflatex -recorder` and mapping the recorded files to their TeX Live packages.
# If a CI build fails with "File `xyz.sty' not found", add xyz's package here.

# Engine, LaTeX format and Finnish hyphenation (loaded through the format, so the recorder misses them)
latex-bin
latex
l3kernel
hyphen-finnish

# Packages loaded by shared/cv-style.sty and its dependencies
amsfonts
babel
babel-finnish
bigintcalc
bitset
cm
colortbl
ec
epstopdf-pkg
etoolbox
fancyhdr
fontawesome
fontaxes
gettitlestring
graphics
graphics-cfg
graphics-def
grfext
hycolor
hyperref
iftex
infwarerr
intcalc
kpathsea
kvdefinekeys
kvoptions
kvsetkeys
lastpage
latexconfig
libertine
ltxcmds
# nameref: hyperref loads it; TeX Live ships it as its own package since Nov 2026
nameref
mptopdf
mweights
pdfescape
pdftexcmds
pgf
preprint
refcount
rerunfilecheck
stringenc
titlesec
tools
uniquecounter
url
xcolor
xkeyval
